theme.description: An authoritative, clean, and function-first design language. Prioritizes clarity, strict grids, and high contrast for an elite HR Portal experience.

core_rules: Strictly enforce the Swiss Brutalist grid layout. Elements must align perfectly. No floating abstract blobs in the dashboard.
Use explicit 1px borders (border-gray-200) for separation instead of soft shadows. Remove all Shadcn default shadows.
Never use Inter for headings. Ensure Outfit and Manrope are imported in the root CSS/HTML.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for complex grids. Use heavily modified Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dialogues.
Implement the 'Traffic Light' protocol strictly: Green ONLY for success/approved, Red ONLY for error/rejected/clock-out, Yellow ONLY for warning/pending/break.
Provide accessible hover states for all interactive elements (e.g., table rows, buttons, nav items). Ensure focus rings are prominent (focus:ring-[#002FA7]).
Do not use generic placeholders (e.g., 'User Avatar'). Use the provided unsplash/pexels images for avatars in the mock data.
Ensure the login page is a 50/50 split layout on desktop: Left side stark white with the login form, Right side featuring the provided 'login_background' image.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='clock-in-btn', data-testid='leave-request-submit').
features_required: Employee Flow: Dashboard with large Clock In/Out/Break widget, Leave Balance summary cards, Leave Request Form (Dialog or dedicated page), Attendance History Table.
Admin Flow: Dashboard with overall headcount/attendance metrics, Leave Request Approval Queue (Table with Accept/Reject buttons), Complete Employee Roster.
Shared: JWT Authentication (Login page with role routing).
